review_method: Source-order full read of all 1200 candidate IDs. The fixed English patch was used as the correction baseline and rationale for localization choices; Japanese was consulted where needed to confirm source semantics, wordplay intent, and resolve ambiguity. Korean was judged for accuracy, naturalness, register, terminology, referents, preserved wordplay where the English patch intentionally preserved it, and obvious text breakage. Final in-scope result: 157 EDIT and 1043 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. All corrections were recorded in docs/audit/beta1-contextual-copyedit-040-reviewed.json and applied through the existing Beta1 reviewed-copyedit queue. Semantic commit 3ec3b0ce67baad039a3206326c813fdf21292f48 passed exact-before application, zero-layout-drift checks, the existing Korean gates, and the English-consumer storage/effective-layout contract before review-basis registration. No historical-range cleanup is credited to this scope.
